== Playoff Rules == Playoff is Best of 5 maps, first to win 3 maps win. Maps are dm2, dm3, steam, schloss, qobblestone. A map can only be played once. First do "rnd team1 team2" to decide who picks first map. Each team get 2 picks each. If a team is down 0-2 in maps they pick the 3rd map and if its 1-2 after the 3rd map the other team picks the 4th map. __NOTOC__
